title: 客户问题跨了部门，怎样接手并给出时间
topic: 从 Amazon 的 Customer Obsession 与 Ownership 两项领导原则中，练习承接客户问题、协调团队并约定跟进时间。

source.title: Leadership Principles
paragraphs: We use our Leadership Principles every day, whether we’re discussing ideas for new projects or deciding on the best way to solve a problem. It’s just one of the things that makes Amazon peculiar.
Leaders start with the customer and work backwards. They work vigorously to earn and keep customer trust. Although leaders pay attention to competitors, they obsess over customers.

Leaders are owners. They think long term and don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. They act on behalf of the entire company, beyond just their own team. They never say “that’s not my job.”
translations: 我们每天都会运用领导原则，无论是在讨论新项目想法，还是在决定如何解决问题时。这些原则也是 Amazon 独特之处之一。
领导者从客户出发，倒推解决办法。他们努力赢得并保持客户信任；虽然也会关注竞争对手，但始终把客户放在首位。
领导者像主人一样思考。他们着眼长远，不为短期收益牺牲长期价值；行动时会考虑整个公司，而不只顾自己的团队。他们不会说“这不是我的工作”。
fullTextParagraphs: We use our Leadership Principles every day, whether we’re discussing ideas for new projects or deciding on the best way to solve a problem. It’s just one of the things that makes Amazon peculiar.
Leaders start with the customer and work backwards. They work vigorously to earn and keep customer trust. Although leaders pay attention to competitors, they obsess over customers.

Leaders are owners. They think long term and don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. They act on behalf of the entire company, beyond just their own team. They never say “that’s not my job.”
verifiedFacts: Amazon 将 Customer Obsession 和 Ownership 列为领导原则。
Ownership 强调从整个公司角度采取行动，而不只考虑自己所在的团队。
Customer Obsession 强调先理解客户需要，再倒推解决办法。

notes.meaning: 在某个时间前向你更新进展
notes.explain: update you by + 时间，明确承诺下次反馈时间。
notes.example: I’ll update you by 3 p.m., even if the review is still in progress.

notes.phrase: act on behalf of the entire company
notes.explain: take ownership of 表示主动负责推进，不只是把问题转交出去。
notes.example: I’ll take ownership of this customer issue.

notes.explain: coordinate with 后接需要一起处理事情的人或团队。
notes.example: I’ll coordinate with the billing team to check the duplicate charge.

scenario.title: 虚构情境：客户账单重复扣款
english: A customer sees a duplicate charge. The billing team is reviewing the transaction, and the customer wants to hear back today.
Reply to the customer, take responsibility for coordination, and set a time for your next update.
chinese: 客户发现账单被重复扣款。财务团队正在核查，客户希望今天得到回复。
请回复客户，说明你会负责协调，并约定下一次更新时间。

firstAttempt.prompt: 虚构情境：客户发现账单被重复扣款，财务团队正在核查。请用英文回复客户：说明你会负责跟进、会与财务团队协调，并承诺今天下午 3 点前更新进度。
firstAttempt.sample: I’ll take ownership of this issue and coordinate with our billing team to check the duplicate charge. I’ll update you by 3 p.m. today, even if the review is still in progress.
firstAttempt.rationale: 接住问题后说清协调动作和下次更新时间。

words.example: I’ll take ownership of the follow-up.
I’ll coordinate with Finance before replying to the customer.
words.translation: 回复客户前，我会先和财务团队协调。

words.example: I’ll send you an update by 3 p.m. today.
words.translation: 我今天下午 3 点前给你更新。

structure.original: Leaders start with the customer and work backwards.
analysis: start with the customer 表示先了解客户真正需要什么。
work backwards 表示从客户需要的结果倒推解法。
处理跨部门问题时，先明确客户需要，再协调负责团队。
structure.transfer: Let’s start with what the customer needs before we choose a solution.

rewrite.bad: That’s a billing issue. Please contact Finance.
rewrite.good: I’ll take ownership of this issue and coordinate with our billing team to check the duplicate charge. I’ll update you by 3 p.m. today.
rewrite.translation: 我会负责跟进这个问题，并和财务团队核查重复扣款。我今天下午 3 点前向你更新。
rewrite.pattern: I’ll take ownership of + 问题. I’ll coordinate with + 团队 + to + 动作. I’ll update you by + 时间.

cloze.prompt: I’ll take ___ of this customer issue.
cloze.why: take ownership of 表示主动负责处理。
coordinate with 表示与某人或团队协调。
by + 时间表示不晚于该时间。

choice.prompt: 客户的问题涉及配送和付款两个团队，客户希望今天收到回复。你应该怎么回应？
options: 告诉客户分别联系两个团队。
先说明自己会协调相关团队，再给出今天的具体更新时间。
等两个团队都处理完再联系客户，不设更新时间。
choice.why: 回应应体现主动跟进，并给客户一个明确的时间预期。

output.prompt: 虚构情境：客户的企业账号无法登录，身份验证团队需要调查。请用英文回复：由你负责协调、说明会联系验证团队，并承诺明天中午前更新。
output.sample: I’ll take ownership of the login issue and coordinate with our identity team to investigate. I’ll update you by noon tomorrow, even if we’re still looking into it.
